title: Custom Furniture & Private House Renovation | DUMSKAYA
description: A DUMSKAYA DESIGN project: design and production of custom furniture and turnkey renovation of a private house. Photos of the completed project.
h1: Custom furniture design and manufacturing, plus a turnkey renovation of a private house

blocks.text: Custom furniture design and manufacturing, plus a turnkey renovation of a private house

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designed and manufactured custom furniture and carried out a comprehensive turnkey renovation of a private house.

Furniture was designed and made for every room of the house: the living room, bedroom, kitchen with custom storage systems and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, bathroom, built-in wardrobes, and shelving.
Each piece of furniture was designed individually, taking into account the architecture and features of the interior, the functional requirements, and the client’s preferences and lifestyle.

Special attention was paid to efficient storage systems, the choice of materials and finishes, furniture proportions, functionality, and the integration of built-in appliances. As a result, the furniture became an integral part of the interior and made it possible to use the space of the house as efficiently as possible.

The comprehensive turnkey project included organizing and carrying out construction and finishing work, manufacturing and installing the furniture, and installing lighting, plumbing fixtures, and other interior elements.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and manufactures custom furniture and delivers interiors and turnkey renovations in Slovakia, across Europe, and in the USA.
